title: 1. Credit Terms list and row menus
h2: 1. Credit Terms list and row menus
note: A new Settings page (no production before): the Active tab, the info tooltips, each kind of row menu, and making a term the default. Light theme.
helmet_css:
<style>
body{margin:0}
/* build geometry (r6-01 / r8): 14px table text, one-line rows, 48px rows */
figure .sv-table { font-size: var(--sv-body-size); }
figure .sv-table td, figure .sv-table th { white-space: nowrap; overflow: visible; }
figure .sv-table td { height: 48px; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
figure .sv-table th { height: 56px; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
.ct-page > .sv-page-head, .ct-page > .sv-tabs-row { margin-left: 0; margin-right: 0; }
.ct-page > .sv-page-head { padding-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
</style>

figures.heading: Active tab: one table
captions: No before: Credit Terms is a new Settings page, so production has nothing to compare. Matches the current build (Active tab).
One table per tab, no sections. Columns: Name, Due, Customers, Vendors, ⋯.

Order: COD, Due on Receipt, Net terms by days (the shop's own Net 10 sits between Net 7 and Net 15), "of the following month" terms by day, any other terms of the shop's own A to Z, Credit Hold last. Terms with the same days sort A to Z.

Due wording: COD "Paid when the invoice is created"; Due on Receipt "Due on the invoice date"; Net X "X days after the invoice date"; day of month "10th of the following month"; Credit Hold "Invoicing is blocked".

COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold are followed by the DS info icon (next two boards) and the lock icon; Net and day-of-month terms have neither, the Due column explains them. Lock hover: "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." (open on COD).
The Customers and Vendors columns show how many customers and vendors are on each term (0 shown as 0). The Customers count never includes the Counter Sale customer.
The default row carries a "Default" badge. New Credit Term is the one primary button, top right; the page ⋯ menu (Audit Log) sits beside it.
Permissions: the page, the terms and the default need Settings → Finance.

Source: Payment Methods uses native tabs on its Settings page (Customer Payments / Vendor Payments, PaymentMethodsTabs.vue), and the Inventory list splits Active and Inactive into tabs (Parts Lifecycle Update PRD 829227015). Tab look matches the Inspection Templates tabs in production: label, then a rounded count pill (selected: blue text, blue underline, light blue pill; unselected: grey text, light grey pill), drawn with DS tokens and the DS Badge.
Source: Payment Methods puts its one add button, "New payment method", at the top right. DS rule: one primary button per view.
Source: DS Badge, info tone, for the "Default" tag. DS lock icon for the three always-available terms.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).
